## Visual QA

If this PR changes any visible 2D, 3D, furniture, design-review, layout, or styling behaviour:

- [ ] I followed `VISUAL_QA.md`.
- [ ] I rendered or opened the affected view.
- [ ] I compared the change with Design 1, a project photo, a screenshot, or another relevant reference.
- [ ] I checked adjacent context for wall continuity, window/door style, labels, flooring, furniture placement, overlays, and layer states.
- [ ] I documented any remaining visual uncertainty.
